details:
Currently, when carrying multiple inventory items, dropping an item causes all carried items to be dropped at the same time. This can be frustrating in many situations because players often only want to remove or give away a single item while keeping the rest of their inventory.

For example:

A player is carrying 50 items and only wants to give 1 item to a friend.

A player accidentally picks up an item and wants to remove only that specific item.

World creators design inventory-based systems where players collect many objects, but users cannot manage them individually.

Roleplay, game worlds, survival worlds, and collection-based experiences would benefit greatly from more precise inventory control.

Suggested Solutions:

1. Allow players to select a specific inventory item and drop only that item.

2. Add a context menu on inventory items with options such as:

Drop Item

 Drop All

Transfer Item

3. Add an inventory wheel or list that allows choosing which item to remove.

4. Include a quick-drop shortcut for the currently selected inventory item.

**Benefits:**

* Better inventory management.

* Improved user experience.

* More flexibility for world creators.

* Better support for roleplay and game-oriented worlds.

* Prevents accidental loss of large inventories.

* Makes item sharing between players much easier.

Example Scenario:

If a player has collected 50 objects during a game session and wants to give only one object to another player, they currently have to drop all 50 objects. This feels unintuitive and creates unnecessary frustration. Being able to drop items individually would solve this problem while maintaining the existing "Drop All" option for players who want it.

This change would significantly improve usability without affecting existing gameplay systems.
title: Allow Dropping Inventory Items Individually Instead of Dropping Everything at Once
